name: Sam Eid
subject: the ad campaigns before the coaching
hook_quote: I spent over 20 years producing advertising campaigns

beats.hook: You spent over 20 years producing advertising campaigns before coaching. Always for somebody else's audience.
beats.identity: I put you in front of executives who'd hire you. Coaches I did that for signed about AED 400k this year.
beats.offer: I pulled 10 names for you before writing this. Not a scraped list, people I'd actually start with.
beats.cta: Give me 15 minutes this week and the 10 are in your inbox before the call ends, plus what ruled the other 40 out.
beats.ps: ps: if it's not for you, say so and I'll leave it there.
